command.name: security key-manager external gcp show
command.description: This command displays the Google Cloud Key Management Service (GCKMS) configuration.

parameter.name: config
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays the GCKMS configuration with given config name.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations for the given Vserver.

parameter.name: project-id
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given project id.

parameter.name: key-ring-name
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given key ring name.

parameter.name: key-ring-location
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given key ring location.

parameter.name: key-name
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given key name.

parameter.name: state
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given state. The state can be either available or unknown.

parameter.name: unavailable-nodes
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given unavailable-nodes.

parameter.name: caller-account
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given caller account.

parameter.name: privileged-account
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given privileged account.

parameter.name: port
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given port number.

parameter.name: oauth-host
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given oauth-host value.

parameter.name: cloudkms-host
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given cloudkms-host value.

parameter.name: verify
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given verify value. The verify value can be either true or false.

parameter.name: verify-host
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given verify-host value. The verify-host value can be either true or false.

parameter.name: verify-ip
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given verify-ip value. The verify-ip value can be either true or false.

parameter.name: proxy-type
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given proxy-type value. The proxy-type value can be either http or https.

parameter.name: proxy-host
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given proxy-host value.

parameter.name: proxy-port
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given proxy-port number.

parameter.name: proxy-username
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given proxy-username value.

parameter.name: oauth-url
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given oauth-url value.

parameter.name: authentication-method
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the GCKMS configurations with the given authentication method value.

example.p: The following example lists all Vservers with GCKMS configuration.
example.screen:
cluster-1::>security key-manager external gcp show Vserver: SAMPLE_VSERVER Project ID: SAMPLE_PROJECT_ID Key Ring Location: SAMPLE_KEY_RING_LOCATION Key Name: SAMPLE_KEY_NAME Caller Account: SAMPLE@CALLER.COM Privileged Account: SAMPLE@PRIVILEGED.COM
Key Ring Name State ------------------------------------------ ------- SAMPLE_KEY_RING_NAME unknown Unavailable Nodes: node1
